## What managing Edgewater takes.

### The Sheridan Road corridor
Edgewater's stretch of Sheridan Road holds one of the densest runs of vintage lakefront high-rises in Chicago, alongside landmark co-op buildings, which we do not serve. For the condominium associations we manage here, wind exposure, aging risers, and facade critical examinations drive capital planning, and we run those cycles daily.

### Bryn Mawr Historic District
The vintage buildings around the Bryn Mawr Red Line stop sit in a designated historic district, where exterior work needs the right approvals and the right masons. We line up both before scaffolding goes up.

### Large buildings, long-tenured residents
Many Edgewater associations combine hundreds of units with decades-long residents and on-site staff. We coordinate staffing, keep communication accessible, and give boards financial reporting that stands up to engaged owners.

## Edgewater boards ask us first.

### Can CenterPoint manage older lakefront high-rises in Edgewater?
Yes, vintage high-rise management is one of our core strengths. Edgewater's lakefront towers need proactive masonry and facade programs, riser and window replacement planning, and reserves that anticipate lakefront weathering. We build board-approved capital calendars for each building.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Edgewater?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Edgewater, Chicago (ZIP 60640, 60660). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Edgewater?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Edgewater association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access. Call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652) or [](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/request-a-proposal).

### How should a Edgewater board compare management companies?
Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois community association management firm license, a licensed manager, a flat monthly fee in writing, after-hours emergency coverage, and a written transition plan.
